distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) report 黑龙江. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds Taiwan as an accepted occurrence.

host_note: Baseline host is Picea koraiensis. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Pinus as usual host and Larix and Picea sometimes; these genus-level records are retained without replacing the species-level Picea koraiensis record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hylurgops glabratus (Zetterstedt, 1828).
